We're driven by speed, ambition, and bold ideas. At our core, we're product creators and problem-solvers who thrive in a high-performance environment. We're looking for exceptional talent—smart, adaptable, and motivated individuals eager to make an impact, scale business functions at pace, and continuously improve. Whether you're a domain expert or an agile thinker who thrives in change, at Patrianna you'll have the freedom to innovate, take ownership, and help us lead the next wave of gaming innovation. Join us—and be part of something extraordinary. The Role You'll keep our cloud platform, apps and AI agents fast, observable and resilient, using automation and AI to make reliability everyone's default. What You Will Be Doing You'll run reproducible, multi-environment cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC). You'll build and own CI/CD pipelines, deployment checks and recovery procedures so shipping is fast and safe. You'll set up logs, metrics, traces and alerts across apps, AI agents and their dependencies. Every alert will be one someone can actually act on. You'll lead incident diagnosis, keep runbooks sharp and regularly test recovery, including safe automated rollback. You'll automate repetitive ops work and use AI to speed up log analysis, root-cause hunting and fixes. You'll make reliability a shared habit by documenting decisions, setting clear SLOs and helping teams own what they ship. What We Are Looking For Strong cloud operations experience, with deep hands-on CI/CD and IaC skills (e.g. Terraform). Confidence diagnosing distributed systems through logs, metrics and traces, including when the clock is ticking. Proven hands-on incident response experience. You've been on call, led the fix and written the post-mortem. Solid scripting skills (e.g. Python, Bash, Go) and strong knowledge of networking, secrets management and service identities. An AI-first approach to automation. You reach for AI tooling to remove toil, not add it. Bonus points for GCP, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Airflow, Vercel, Supabase, Kubernetes or OpenTelemetry, plus SLO/error-budget experience. Why you will love it Real ownership: You won't just maintain someone else's setup. You'll shape how we build, ship and recover. Cool stuff, at scale: Your work keeps games running smoothly for millions of players. No-nonsense culture: We're direct, transparent and accountable. Conversations happen in open Slack channels, outcomes are documented in Monday.com, and deadlines are agreed, not imposed. Progress over perfectionism: We ship, learn and improve, and we don't wait for perfect. Great people only: We have high standards, a strong team spirit and a strict no ass-hole policy. Connected, wherever you are: We use Google Meet with cameras on, because we like actually knowing each other. Equal Opportunities We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas — nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.

Mientras la ciudad se prepara para una nueva estación, hay algo que debe seguir funcionando a la perfección: la tecnología que permite que cada jornada transcurra sin interrupciones. Buscamos un/a Técnico/a de Soporte Local presencial con experiencia, autonomía y orientación N2, que disfrute ayudando a los usuarios y sepa desenvolverse con especial atención en entornos de Alta Dirección y usuarios VIP. Si eres una persona resolutiva, discreta y con vocación de servicio, ¡queremos conocerte! 🍁 ¿Cuál será tu misión? Proporcionar soporte presencial a usuarios, incluidos perfiles VIP y Alta Dirección. Diagnosticar y resolver incidencias N1/N2 de puesto de trabajo. Gestionar incidencias y peticiones mediante herramientas de ticketing. Preparar y dar soporte a reuniones y salas de videoconferencia. Maquetar y desplegar equipos Windows y Mac mediante SCCM/MECM e Intune (Autopilot). Configurar y dar soporte a dispositivos móviles iPhone y Android. Resolver incidencias relacionadas con Microsoft 365: Teams, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint y OneDrive. Gestionar altas, bajas, desbloqueos y permisos en Directorio Activo. Controlar el inventario y gestionar los puestos de trabajo. Realizar actuaciones de manos remotas en salas técnicas: comprobación de equipos, cableado, conexiones, alimentación y reinicios autorizados. Acompañar a técnicos externos y colaborar en instalaciones, cambios y diagnósticos. Escalar incidencias a los equipos especializados y realizar su seguimiento hasta la resolución. 🌰 ¿Qué buscamos? Experiencia en soporte técnico presencial a usuarios, preferiblemente en entornos corporativos. Experiencia en atención a usuarios VIP y Alta Dirección. Conocimientos de soporte N1/N2 de puesto de trabajo. Experiencia con Windows, Mac, SCCM/MECM e Intune. Conocimientos de Microsoft 365 y dispositivos móviles. Experiencia en herramientas de ticketing y Directorio Activo. Conocimientos básicos de soporte en salas técnicas y actuaciones de manos remotas. Buenas habilidades de comunicación, discreción, autonomía y orientación al usuario. 🍂 ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Proyecto presencial en Barcelona. Jornada organizada en turnos dentro de una modalidad de servicio 24x7. Incorporación a un entorno tecnológico donde tu experiencia y capacidad de respuesta serán fundamentales. Este otoño, conviértete en una pieza clave para que la tecnología nunca se detenga. ¿Te apuntas al reto?
